name: LLM Gateway
short: Open-source (AGPLv3) multi-provider AI gateway and proxy with 250+ models, self-hosting support, 5% credit platform fees, and DevPass flat-rate subscriptions for AI coding agents.

plans.name: Open Source & Free Tier (BYOK)
plans.notes: Self-host the AGPLv3 gateway on your own infra, or bring your own keys with $0 platform fee; access to hosted zero-cost models (rate-limited ~20 RPM) without credit card.

plans.name: Managed Credits
plans.notes: No subscription required; top up unified credits to access 250+ models across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-weight hosts with a flat 5% platform fee.

plans.name: DevPass Lite
plans.notes: Flat-rate AI coding pass including $58 in monthly model usage across Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, and OpenCode with fair-use limits.

plans.name: DevPass Pro
plans.notes: Flat-rate coding subscription including $158 in monthly model usage with higher frontier model velocity limits.
